scope: Prior-art and architecture proposals. No production or frozen M3 modifications.

recommendation.label: to_test
recommendation.architecture: Joint point-and-line evidence, explicit identity/pitch/orientation hypotheses, regularized hierarchy of geometric models, original-RGB footprint sampling and separate calibrated geometry support.

proposals.title: Joint integer decoder with pitch and skipped-line hypotheses
proposals.label: to_test
proposals.documented_precursor: Directional cycles, semantic IDs and major/minor periodicity are already disclosed mechanisms.
proposals.hypothesis: Representing edge jumps as integers and keeping pitch hypotheses will reduce coherent 2x/5x scale failures without discarding physically correct sparse grids.
design: Separate local position p_i and covariance from integer row/column n_i, major/minor class and physical pitch q.
Allow candidate jumps delta_ij in a bounded integer set, including skipped rows and columns.
Require cycle-integrable IDs and reciprocal compatibility, but do not use these as a scale certificate.
Score hypotheses with observed intervening lines and major/minor evidence, plus independent calibration cues when present.
Return multiple hypotheses or unresolved unit when the image is not identifying.
Use bounded candidate graphs and prune by an input-only beam. Report runtime and retained hypotheses.
proposals.acceptance: More correct supported physical queries at a predeclared bound on wrong coverage and catastrophic scale error, on new held-out cases. Ambiguity controls must not receive confident incompatible units.
risks: All candidates can share a wrong detector prior
proposals.not_sufficient: Cycles alone cannot resolve an observationally identical harmonic alias.

proposals.title: Independent semantic orientation and component phase
proposals.label: to_test
proposals.hypothesis: Text orientation and verified layout cues can resolve D4 without gold, while explicit local gauges preserve useful disconnected geometry.
design: Estimate D4 using readable text, lead names and metadata. Keep semantic orientation separate from lattice axis selection.
Do not fit a universal homography through lead-marker positions unless the exact metric template is established.
Retain every plausible grid component with its local row/column gauge.
Infer relative integer offset only from observed line continuation or a separately scored global/template hypothesis.
Export orientation_resolved and component_phase_resolved independently from map numerical validity.
proposals.acceptance: Correct orientation on observed semantic evidence, explicit ambiguity on symmetric evidence, and no silent component deletion or fabricated phase.
risks: Photocopy reflection and image rotation combine
proposals.not_sufficient: A positive determinant cannot choose clinical direction.

proposals.title: Dual-family line evidence with original-resolution subpixel localization
proposals.label: to_test
proposals.hypothesis: Grid-line geometry and anisotropic localization improve association and physical accuracy over point heatmap centroids alone.
design: Predict line families, intersection evidence and major/minor class in an economical-resolution frontend.
Refine crossing positions using patches from original RGB or grid probability at original coordinates.
Compare intensity centroids, robust local two-line intersections and learned offsets under identical downstream decoding.
Estimate or learn anisotropic localization covariance and retain association/pitch uncertainty separately.
Compare discrete line instances against continuous two-phase fields with anchored phase unwrapping.
Reserve whole line segments for independent geometric checks.
fair_ablations: each localizer at identical detector and topology
proposals.acceptance: Lower independently measured source-coordinate bias and mm error, with reliability curves stratified by angle, blur and scale. No improvement credited solely to more output resolution.
risks: A covariance model can miss systematic bias
proposals.not_sufficient: Subpixel precision does not imply correct row/column ID.

proposals.title: Regularized projective-residual model hierarchy with shared edges
proposals.label: to_test
proposals.hypothesis: A residual that can shrink to zero will preserve planar denoising while allowing real nonplanar corrections.
design: Compare H alone, current mesh, continuous T composed after H, and shared-curved-edge interpolation in the H-normalized domain.
Use weights derived from localization covariance, robust residual penalties and a declared residual regularizer.
Remove redundant affine/projective residual modes or otherwise fix the H/residual gauge.
Keep one forward/inverse representation with horizon, conditioning, fold and overlap checks.
Choose complexity using held-out line or region evidence. Never use per-image gold model selection.
Allow a crease discontinuity in derivatives when supported. Do not require global C1.
Retain all M3 negative controls, including noisy plane and coherent corruption.
proposals.acceptance: Exact projective planar limit and C0 contracts, then improved G/W tail tradeoff across independently specified noise and nonplanarity. No universal promotion from lower average RMSE.
risks: Inverse failures hidden by support erosion
proposals.not_sufficient: Held-out nodes with the same coherent wrong IDs cannot certify absolute scale.

proposals.title: Content-preserving canvas and provenance independent of grid evidence
proposals.label: to_test
proposals.hypothesis: Separating content, canvas, sampling validity and metric evidence prevents avoidable deletion while keeping geometry claims honest.
design: Never multiply original RGB by the grid confidence mask.
Compute canvas from visible paper/content and candidate mapping, not only detected grid bounding box.
Represent observed support, inferred holes, extrapolated margins, unresolved phase and occlusion as different states.
For nonidentifiable regions, retain the original image and declare partial geometry rather than fill valid coordinates with sentinel zero.
Audit the actual delivered RGB for crop, out-of-bounds remap, explicit zero write and sampling-contrast loss.
Do not count original preservation as completed rectification.
fair_ablations: same map with provenance-only geometry mask
proposals.acceptance: All visible source markers in the declared paper domain remain accounted for. Unobserved geometric claims remain explicitly unsupported. No increase in correct coverage is created by changing denominator.
risks: Inaccurate extrapolation moves content off canvas
A fallback is mistaken for successful warp
proposals.not_sufficient: Keeping the input file does not by itself prove that the delivered rectified view preserved content.

proposals.title: Original-RGB footprint sampling and physiology-preserving objectives
proposals.label: to_test
proposals.hypothesis: Composed source sampling with anisotropic footprint integration reduces thin-trace loss without generating waveform pixels.
design: Use restored/normalized images only as detector inputs and retain original RGB for final sampling.
Compose all geometric transforms into one map before RGB resampling.
Select adaptive tiled sampling from local Jacobian singular values and the source footprint.
Evaluate linear-light versus coded-RGB averaging separately if a radiometric claim is needed.
Use known grid/text straightness as geometric evidence, but preserve the original curvature of ECG traces.
If studying coordinate diffusion, sample original RGB using its map and audit all geometric failures. Do not treat generated map variability as calibrated error.
fair_ablations: same exact map and output scale
proposals.acceptance: Better thin-trace/spike energy retention at fixed geometry, with bounded blur and runtime. Must retain M3 broad-line and phase controls.
risks: More integration blurs useful high frequencies
proposals.not_sufficient: Higher pixels/mm cannot recover information destroyed by an earlier resize or by capture.

proposals.title: Metric physical surface candidate with explicit crease and camera model
proposals.label: to_test
proposals.hypothesis: A developable surface prior can improve physically plausible completion and crease localization when line evidence is sparse.
design: Model material coordinates, 3D sheet and camera projection jointly, including a lens hypothesis when needed.
Penalize metric stretch in visible regions and allow normals to jump on explicit creases.
Use a learned coarse surface only as initialization/prior, then fit observed grid evidence.
Represent occlusion and visibility instead of forcing every material point into a single bijection.
Retain flat H and continuous 2D residual as simpler competitors.
proposals.acceptance: Improved physical-coordinate accuracy on unseen 3D geometries and real captures with independent reference. Hidden regions must remain unobserved.
risks: Paper stretch or printer deformation violates isometry
Camera and surface distortion compensate each other
proposals.not_sufficient: A visually plausible or developable fitted surface need not be the true hidden surface.

proposals.title: Independent real and physical-reference evaluation
proposals.label: to_test
proposals.hypothesis: Independent physical geometry and real invisible-reference captures expose failures masked by matching renderer priors.
design: Keep M3 retrospective only and reserve new patients, physical geometries, acquisition devices and texture/layout sources.
Use a separately implemented physical camera/surface reference and audit metric preservation.
Consider invisible-reference real capture inspired by UVDoc, with independently measured motion and localization error.
Deduplicate ECG-image-database, PM-ECG-ID and PTB-XL-derived datasets by original ECG/patient and capture lineage.
Use modest, stratified physical samples rather than downloading an entire multi-terabyte dataset without a clear experimental need.
proposals.acceptance: Frozen protocol, hash manifest, independent reference error budget and complete saved outputs. Report results by source and failure family.
risks: Calibration pattern leaks into normal image
Synthetic ground truth shares implementation with candidate
proposals.not_sufficient: A new publication date does not make an old dataset an unseen holdout.

proposals.title: Reliability calibrated by failure cause and support regime
proposals.label: to_test
proposals.hypothesis: Separate uncertainty components yield better input-only abstention than detector score or warp smoothness alone.
design: Keep localization, association, unit, orientation, model-selection and extrapolation uncertainty distinct.
Predict or calibrate errors using independent development groups and source-stratified reliability diagrams.
Evaluate risk versus returned coverage at a fixed paper-query denominator.
Use whole image/patient groups for intervals and threshold calibration. Do not count pixels as independent observations.
Expose out-of-support states for unknown layouts, camera artifacts and ambiguous scale.
proposals.acceptance: Wrong coverage and catastrophic error calibrated on held-out source groups, with appropriate uncertainty and no hidden zero-coverage success.
proposals.not_sufficient: A calibrated score on one population is not a universal certificate under arbitrary domain shift.

proposals.title: Authentic comparison contract and bounded claims
proposals.label: to_test
proposals.hypothesis: Explicit native support and complete accounting prevent a misleading superiority claim while exposing genuine gains.
design: Distinguish published main npj, experimental TPS, each supported Kaggle solution and unavailable commercial access.
Run authentic public sources with pinned weights/configuration and preserve their native behavior.
Report supported-layout and full-deployment strata separately, without excluding failures from either scheduled denominator.
Score geometry, visible RGB preservation and waveform in separate tracks.
Do not call an independently coded primitive a commercial implementation.
Register allowed translation gauge and disallow oracle D4/scale in the primary endpoint.
proposals.acceptance: All cases, warnings, failures, timeouts and unavailable arms are present. Claims match the tested endpoint, population and exact implementation.
risks: Unsupported Kaggle layouts mistaken for leaderboard reproduction
Unavailable commercial output replaced by simulation
proposals.not_sufficient: A better diagnostic synthetic score does not establish universal, clinical or commercial superiority.

falsification_cases.label: to_test
falsification_cases.name: Indistinguishable evidence
falsification_cases.construction: Byte-identical raster assigned two different true pitches, or two clinical D4 orientations after deleting semantic cues.
falsification_cases.falsifies: Universal confident identification from a symmetric grid.
falsification_cases.expected: Ambiguity or multiple hypotheses. At least one hard answer must be wrong by construction.

falsification_cases.label: to_test
falsification_cases.name: Coherent harmonic omission
falsification_cases.construction: Remove every second major line, remove minor lines, or make major/minor indistinguishable while retaining perfect cycles.
falsification_cases.falsifies: Cycle closure implies correct mm pitch.
falsification_cases.expected: Retain scale candidates unless independent evidence identifies the correct one.

falsification_cases.label: to_test
falsification_cases.name: Exact strong perspective
falsification_cases.construction: Perfect observed points and line curves under a known nondegenerate homography, including large local spacing variation.
falsification_cases.falsifies: Global nearest-distance/angle clusters organize all valid grids.
falsification_cases.expected: Exact planar map or explicit unsupported status without fictitious node noise.

falsification_cases.label: to_test
falsification_cases.name: Independent camera and backend
falsification_cases.construction: Unseen renderer/camera and physical surface families with fixed material coordinates.
falsification_cases.falsifies: Generalization inferred from a shared generator or viewed development bank.
falsification_cases.expected: Complete source-stratified geometry results.

falsification_cases.label: to_test
falsification_cases.name: Variable skipped lines
falsification_cases.construction: Change missing-row counts across the same image and insert local false intersections.
falsification_cases.falsifies: One global pitch or consecutive IDs handle all gaps.
falsification_cases.expected: Correct integer jump estimates or bounded partial support.

falsification_cases.label: to_test
falsification_cases.name: D4 with conflicting semantics
falsification_cases.construction: Rotate/reflect all inputs, obscure some lead labels, add a false text orientation cue, vary layout.
falsification_cases.falsifies: Landscape or lattice direction determines clinical orientation.
falsification_cases.expected: Use independent cues and expose unresolved conflicts.

falsification_cases.label: to_test
falsification_cases.name: Separated components
falsification_cases.construction: Two equal or unequal correct grids separated by missing columns, with varied integer phase and a larger false grid elsewhere.
falsification_cases.falsifies: Largest component equals correct full-page geometry.
falsification_cases.expected: Retain components and explicitly unresolved relative phase.

falsification_cases.label: to_test
falsification_cases.name: Unobservable fold inside hole
falsification_cases.construction: Different physical interiors with identical observed grid around an occluded or grid-free hole.
falsification_cases.falsifies: Regression or smoothness observes hidden geometry.
falsification_cases.expected: Mark completion as inferred and avoid confident physical coverage there.

falsification_cases.label: to_test
falsification_cases.name: Blur and phase localization
falsification_cases.construction: Directional blur, subpixel line shifts, opening angles and input scales swept independently of the warp model.
falsification_cases.falsifies: Heatmap confidence or centroid precision implies unbiased crossing position.
falsification_cases.expected: Source-coordinate error and anisotropic uncertainty assessed independently.

falsification_cases.label: to_test
falsification_cases.name: Trace/grid overlap
falsification_cases.construction: Dense QRS, long isoelectric segments, labels and ink crossings overlap grid nodes and lines.
falsification_cases.falsifies: Dark straight evidence always belongs to the grid.
falsification_cases.expected: Identity and localization uncertainty rise without deleting source content.

falsification_cases.label: to_test
falsification_cases.name: Appearance harmonic artifacts
falsification_cases.construction: Monitor moire, JPEG, rescaling, screen subpixels, doubled scan or aliasing produce a second regular pattern.
falsification_cases.falsifies: Strong periodic response identifies the physical paper lattice.
falsification_cases.expected: Competing lattices exposed and independent cues used.

falsification_cases.label: to_test
falsification_cases.name: Competing false grid
falsification_cases.construction: Background tablecloth or form table has more confident nodes than the ECG lattice.
falsification_cases.falsifies: Largest or most regular component is necessarily the target.
falsification_cases.expected: Paper/semantic support selects target or ambiguity is declared.

falsification_cases.label: to_test
falsification_cases.name: Noisy plane
falsification_cases.construction: Planar H with independent heteroscedastic and correlated localization errors, including anisotropy.
falsification_cases.falsifies: Interpolating local residual always beats global H.
falsification_cases.expected: Regularized or zero residual can win, all losses retained.

falsification_cases.label: to_test
falsification_cases.name: Smooth physical curvature
falsification_cases.construction: Cylinder, ruled sheet and inextensible nonplanar sheet under perspective with exact and noisy observations.
falsification_cases.falsifies: Global H sufficient for every image.
falsification_cases.expected: Meaningful physical improvement without seams or unit errors.

falsification_cases.label: to_test
falsification_cases.name: True crease
falsification_cases.construction: Aligned and oblique crease, crease through a cell interior, varying camera obliquity.
falsification_cases.falsifies: Global C1 smoothness is always physically correct.
falsification_cases.expected: Preserve continuity while allowing derivative jump and explicit uncertain localization.

falsification_cases.label: to_test
falsification_cases.name: Coherent wrong correspondence
falsification_cases.construction: Shift a whole row or half sheet by consistent integer IDs, preserving local closure and smoothness.
falsification_cases.falsifies: Robust residual, holdout points or positive Jacobian certify correct IDs.
falsification_cases.expected: Independent identity evidence catches it or false confidence remains visible.

falsification_cases.label: to_test
falsification_cases.name: Lens and acquisition model mismatch
falsification_cases.construction: Radial lens distortion, rolling shutter, anisotropic scanner scale and photographed monitor over a known sheet.
falsification_cases.falsifies: All nonprojectivity is paper curvature.
falsification_cases.expected: Model mismatch reported and physically valid alternatives compared.

falsification_cases.label: to_test
falsification_cases.name: Grid-free visible content
falsification_cases.construction: Place trace, text, pulse and margin markers outside detected grid or inside grid-free paper.
falsification_cases.falsifies: Missing grid permits blank RGB.
falsification_cases.expected: Every visible marker accounted for in original and declared output canvas.

falsification_cases.label: to_test
falsification_cases.name: Thin strokes and spikes
falsification_cases.construction: Sweep subpixel phase, orientation and width at the same exact geometry and output px/mm.
falsification_cases.falsifies: Exact coordinates guarantee signal visibility after bilinear point sampling.
falsification_cases.expected: Independent footprint and contrast/energy measurements.

falsification_cases.label: to_test
falsification_cases.name: Nonstandard calibration
falsification_cases.construction: 25/50 mm/s, 5/10/20 mm/mV, variable pulse shapes/durations, mixed per-lead gain, OCR errors and cropped metadata.
falsification_cases.falsifies: A detected rectangular pulse automatically supplies a standard physical unit.
falsification_cases.expected: Declared calibration track and unresolved unit where evidence conflicts.

falsification_cases.label: to_test
falsification_cases.name: Unknown and partial layout
falsification_cases.construction: Uncataloged lead order, partial lead strip, atypical paper dimensions, no complete border.
falsification_cases.falsifies: Known template can be applied universally.
falsification_cases.expected: Native support reported without forced semantic IDs.

falsification_cases.label: to_test
falsification_cases.name: Pixel convention stress
falsification_cases.construction: Odd sizes, half-pixel translations, inclusive corners, portrait rotations and asymmetric local footprints.
falsification_cases.falsifies: A visually close adapter necessarily preserves source geometry.
falsification_cases.expected: Coordinate-ramp and saved pixel parity checks.

falsification_cases.label: to_test
falsification_cases.name: Output accounting failures
falsification_cases.construction: Canvas crop, remap outside image, invalid-cell holes, zero sentinels and truncated saved PNG.
falsification_cases.falsifies: Successful return status or input preservation proves delivered RGB success.
falsification_cases.expected: Atomic save, full decode and explicit failure/provenance receipts.

falsification_cases.label: to_test
falsification_cases.name: True occlusion and foldover
falsification_cases.construction: Opaque hand or self-overlapping fold with separate visibility ground truth.
falsification_cases.falsifies: Single-image rectification can recover the hidden waveform as measured content.
falsification_cases.expected: Visible geometry only, occlusion status and no invented signal.

documented: NPJ main and its experimental TPS are different arms
Official modern document mechanisms and repository inventories were checked
inferred: Coherent cycles do not identify pitch
Grid symmetry does not identify clinical D4
Unseen geometry inside a hole is not observed
Original-RGB sampling does not make a wrong map physically correct
to_test: Any gain over authentic npj, supported Kaggle or authorized Powerful Medical execution
